podcast.title: Biblical Reverence (Goth Band)
podcast.body: Mentioned as a notable band from the era, with "biblical reverence" in their name, indicating a characteristic aesthetic element within the goth scene. "Fields of the Nephilim. Nice biblical reverence there."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Cult Goth Status
podcast.body: Fields of the Nephilim was one of a series of bands in the latter half of the 1980s that, while not mainstream, were huge parts of the Goth cult. "This included the mission, Fields of the Nephilim, Redlory Yellowlory, Clan of Zimox, the March of Iluits and a slew of others."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
